payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image depict the source image as a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED: assess whether the depicted source content is actually rendered in a chalk-drawing visual form across the scene, rather than merely receiving a chalk-like texture or overlay. A scene-wide chalk-made rendering is complete. A mixed rendering is partial when the scene has a concrete chalk-drawing appearance but substantial depicted content still reads as photographic; residual photographic detail alone does not make an otherwise genuinely chalk-made drawing incomplete.
node.binding: SOURCE is the image to transform; EDITED must show that same image rendered as a chalk drawing. Evaluate the rendering of the source scene and its depicted content, not texture alone.
node.source_quote: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
node.endpoint: The source image is rendered as a chalk-made drawing.
node.necessity: This is the requested transformation itself; without it, the instruction is not fulfilled.
node.zero_when: The edited image shows no requested chalk-drawing transformation of the source image; unrelated edits or a texture overlay without chalk rendering of depicted content do not count.
node.half_when: The source image has a concrete chalk-drawing appearance across the scene, but the rendering is mixed: substantial depicted content still reads as photographic or retains photographic structure, so the image does not yet read overall as a chalk-made drawing. Do not treat residual photographic detail alone as incomplete when the scene genuinely reads as chalk-made.
node.full_when: The edited image presents the source image’s depicted content across the scene as a drawing made from chalk, allowing natural variation in lighting, texture, and photographic detail; photographic detail may remain, but the scene should genuinely read as a chalk-made drawing rather than merely having a chalk-like overlay or texture.

node_traces.evidence: The same two giraffes and surrounding scene are rendered throughout with soft, grainy, smudged shading and drawn outlines characteristic of a chalk drawing. The background, ground, and foliage are also painterly rather than photographic; the retained giraffe markings and scene details do not prevent the image from reading overall as chalk-made.
